details.description:

developer velocity and reduce development effort for building applications. application's core functionality.

details.description:
Performed extensive data and image pre-processing such as denoising, morphological operations, sampling for balancing the dataset according to classes, and image augmentation.
Tested and trained on three types of convolutional neural networks that have worked well for image classification tasks.
RESNET152v2, InceptionV3, and Densenet201 were trained, hyperparameter tuned, and evaluated. Mean accuracies of 96%, 94%, and 97% were respectively obtained

Text preprocessing like vectorizing and batch generation was performed on a dataset that comprised 5M + characters.
LSTM recurrent neural network with an embedding layer was implemented and trained to create an AI to imitate Shakespeare’s sonnets.
The model was trained on over 7M parameters and a loss of 1.07 was obtained in the final output.
The text was generated to show how well the model had performed and how it had captured the essence of Shakespeare's writing format

Implemented N-Layered Neural Network from scratch using NumPy on MNIST dataset.
Gradients, weights and biases, cost function, activation functions, and forward/backward propagation were calculated.
The model can be applied to supervised learning problems for multiclass classification.
An accuracy of 93% was obtained

details.description: The project "Smart Irrigation Using IoT" strives to modernize conventional irrigation methods by harnessing the capabilities of Internet of Things (IoT) technology. Through the integration of sensors, data analysis, and automation, the project aims to enhance water usage efficiency in agricultural and landscaping contexts, resulting in minimized water wastage.

The paper "Smart Irrigation Using IoT" is dedicated to modernizing traditional irrigation practices by harnessing the capabilities of Internet of Things (IoT) technology. By seamlessly integrating sensors, data analysis, and automation, the paper aims to optimize water utilization efficiency in both agricultural and landscaping scenarios, ultimately leading to a reduction in wasteful water consumption.

work_experiences.job_description:
Red Star Simulation is a 3rd party development studio for a commercial flight simulator called DCS:World. We make pilot-oriented modules, with the primary focus on accurate flight dynamics.

My role in the team is as follows:
- Generating and upscaling 3D assets.
- Texturing 3D assets using PBR workflow. 

This is a remote job and I am employed as an independent contractor. My contract will end well before the 2024 fall semester begins.

Website: https://redstarsimulations.com/

details.description:
Community project to build simulation modules for modern 4th gen combat aircraft, namely Sukhoi Su-30, Su-35 and Su-34
Main team consists of 4 people + a lot of community contributors. My role is 3D modeler , texture artist and also programmer for flight model(using C++ and lua)

technical_papers.title: COMPUTATIONAL STUDY OF LUNG AIRFLOW PATTERN FOR MULTIPLE DISEASE CONDITIONS

details.description: Our aim was to generate accurate CAD model of upper airway based on existing mathematical model and perform CFD to monitor flow behavior and attributes. We also generated extremely detailed CAD models derived from CT scan data of various patients. These were also monitored using CFD. Together, these attempts represent both theoretical and experimental sides. Overall, our attempts provide an opportunity for subject matter experts to take an in depth look into the airflow behavior inside the lung.

work_experiences.job_description:
> Developed backend for Business Intelligence tools.
> Built and deployed several backend services over AWS.
> Learned and experienced project management, software development life cycle and code organization and maintenance.

> Developed microservices for internal use and tools for client use.
> Developed end-to-end pipelines for statistical and machine learning use cases and generating useful dashboards for analysis
from raw data.
> Worked closely with product owners and experienced the evolution of a product right from requirement-analysis to a deliverable.

> Part of the Syncron.AI and DataOps division.
> In charge of developing and maintaining the infrastructure and services for Syncron’s Data Platform.
> In charge of developing and maintaining microservices and infrastructure for Syncron’s AI/ML platform.
> In charge of implementing PoCs for advanced analytics.

details.description:
> Participated in E-yantra 2016 [ Theme: Cross A Crater ]
> Qualified to Stage-2
> Programmed the Firebird-V robot with a mechanical arm developed using servo motors
> Detected the arena using Computer Vision and calculated the moves for the robot to place the boulders and cross the crater. 
> Successfully performed One-Armed Push-Ups using the robot :3

> Trained neural networks to recognize handwritten Kannada characters.
> Utilized a combination of feature regularization, augmentation techniques and label propagation to reduce reliance on training
data, achieving 99.13% accuracy.

> Participated in ACM ICPC
> Qualified for Asia Regional at IIT Kharagpur
> Secured 61 rank

details.description:
Created software to digitize the college laundry system, with a focus on
minimizing the carbon footprint associated with hostel laundry collection and
distribution processes

Produced a code file that automates the organization of files into folders at a
designated path, effectively decreasing the need for manual sorting of individual
files
Using Basic ML models, we can train and validate the data set and can get upto 95% accuracy on detecting faces in real time.
To enhance the experience and remove the tedious and redundant job of entering and maintain data in an excel.

Automating the process of converting an image to greyscale and resizing it to the user's desired size. Futher, the converted image would be sent to the user via email provided. Also tinkered with storing the user input to Cloud Storage (Amazon S3 bucket)

details.description:
Transforming Two-Wheeler Transportation

Our project involved retrofitting a standard two-wheeler with a dual fuel system, utilizing both petrol and gas. The vehicle starts on petrol and seamlessly transitions to gas, optimizing fuel efficiency. This innovation reduces fuel costs, virtually eliminates pollution, and significantly increases mileage. It’s a sustainable and economically viable solution for modern transportation.

work_experiences.job_description: Worked as part of MII team for about 1 year and 8 months. Worked on full stack web development mostly using react JS for UI/UX and Spring Boot, Java and PostgreSQL for backend. Some of my major contributions are Autodetection of data feed settings like the File encoding, delimiter and quote characters within a file. I have also worked on emailed reports and a few DAGS on GCP airflow which deliver reports on a scheduled basis. I have worked closely with the QA team, to provide details on testing.

details.description: Worked on a billing system as a minor project that could be used in any stores or restaurants to ease the process of money management. As a major project we worked on an automation tool that could record and store actions of keyboard and mouse in the exact same order of events and replay them as many times as necessary with highest possible accuracy. This helps reduce time on repetitive tasks.

Bringing Hope is a platform where the social service organisations like trust funds, NGOs can get into contact with donators in their locality so that they can improve the reach of their campaigns.

To improve the speed of website I used React Redux library.
